acip: YI DVAGS LA CHU KLUNG RNAG KHRAG TU SNANG BA NI DE'I MIG SHES LA SNANG BA YIN PAS GZUGS KYI SKYE MCHED DU GZHAG DGOS SO,,
english: When a stream of clear water appears, to a craving spirit, as though it were pus & blood, it is making its appearance to the consciousness of the eye. As such, we would have to categorize it too as belonging to the sense door of visible form.
wylie: yi dvags la chu klung rnag khrag tu snang ba ni de'i mig shes la snang ba yin pas gzugs kyi skye mched du gzhag dgos so
